analytics.title: Help us improve Loom
analytics.description: With your permission, Google Analytics helps us count visitors and understand how our public pages are used. Optional analytics stays off until you allow it.
analytics.settingsDescription: Choose whether this browser sends optional analytics. Changing this setting does not affect sign-in or purchases.
analytics.excludeBrowserDescription: Use this for your own browsing and tests. This preference is shared across Loom subdomains on this browser.
